verdict.rationale: Notion's API supports read/write on pages and databases (notion-docs-1) and webhooks let integrations subscribe to real-time events like page/property changes (notion-docs-3), which together give engineers the primitives to build custom trigger-and-action automations via scripts or PATs (notion-docs-2). However, there's no evidence of a native no-code 'if-this-then-action' automation rule builder inside Notion itself—only API/webhook building blocks requiring custom development. Missing for 10: documentation of Notion's built-in automation/rules feature (e.g., database automations, buttons-as-triggers), concrete example automations, and independent confirmation that engineers successfully built such workflows.
